name: Clip-on feet for play yard fence (North States Superyard)

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a parametric clip-on foot designed to stabilize a play yard fence. It features a long, low-profile horizontal base that curves upward on both sides to form a central raised housing. A rectangular slot is cut through this central housing from the bottom, creating a clip-on channel with inward-facing retention lips to securely grip the bottom rail of a fence.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric clip-on foot for a play yard fence bottom rail. The foot must feature a long, low-profile base with a central raised bridge containing a slot to snap onto the rail, utilizing adjustable parameters for total length, width, rail dimensions, floor gap clearance, and clip thickness.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a main module that performs boolean difference operations on a base cube of dimensions [wid, len, h+thk]. Cylinders are rotated and subtracted to create the large curved transitions on either side of the central bridge. The bottom channel slot is formed by subtracting two overlapping rectangular cubes to create a T-shaped or lip-retaining cavity. Custom fillet helper modules, built from a subtracted cylinder and cube, smooth the top and bottom outer corners.
